newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki falters on weak forestries and Motorola warning.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki falters on weak forestries and Motorola warning.

text.p: Shares ended a jittery bourse session slightly lower on a slide in telecoms major Nokia and weakness in forestries, brokers said.
The HEX index fell 0.98 percent to 2,102.17. Decliners led advancers 40 to 27, with 27 issues unchanged. Trading was fairly lively with volume reaching 392 million markka.

Nokia, which was down sharply during the session, closed official trade down four markka at 187.00, but it largely recovered from an initial shock after U.S. rival Motorola warned of weaker third-quarter earnings.

"It is too early to say whether Motorola's earnings warning was only bad news for Nokia," one broker said. "But in the short term, the Motorola warning is likely to depress the whole technology sector," he added.
Forestries tracked Swedish paper stocks lower, pulling the sub-index down 2.12 percent.
"There were clear selling pressures in forestries today, and it seemed to be a Nordic phenomenon," one broker said.
Forestry giant UPM-Kymmene closed down two markka at 99.00, in low volume, and Enso shed 0.80 markka to 36.50.
